# S2 gofile: an all-.go package under the logos driver keeps plain
# semantics. The hand-written marker evaluates its call at the
# statement, which shows recognition never fires for .go files.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos run .
stdout '(?m)^go-f\ngo-stmt$'

# Recognition is extension-gated to loGo/s files: a built binary keeps
# the same plain order.
logos build -o $WORK/gofile$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/gofile$GOEXE
stdout '(?m)^go-f\ngo-stmt$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/defergofile

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	rt "logos/rt"
)

func g() error {
	fmt.Println("go-f")
	return nil
}

func goGuarded() (err error) {
	defer rt.DeferTry(&err, g())
	fmt.Println("go-stmt")
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := goGuarded(); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("FAIL unexpected error")
		return
	}
}
